svg.title: Map intent to host networking resources
svg.desc: In a separated design, management and compute use SET and a virtual switch, while storage uses standalone RDMA adapters and SMB Multichannel. In a fully converged design, the approved combined intent creates SET, a virtual switch, and host virtual interfaces for management and storage alongside VM interfaces. Network ATC owns host construction, not switch policy.
svg.text: Map intent to host networking resources
Read each lane from left to right: declared intent, host construction, then interfaces.

g.text: SET is switch-independent, not host-facing LACP. SMB Multichannel is a different mechanism.
Network ATC owns these host resources; physical-switch policy and workload NSGs have separate owners.
